newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Woolworth to seek Athens listing.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Woolworth to seek Athens listing.

text.p: F.W. Woolworth & Co (Cyprus) on Thursday said it would apply for a listing on the Athens stock exchange before the end of the year.
The company, a subsidiary of N.K. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd., said it planned to issue share capital worth up to 6.5 million pounds ($12.2 million) through the Athens bourse.
"The board of directors is confident that F.W. Woolworth's admittance to the the Athens Stock Exchange will be complete within 1997," a statement from the company said.
F.W. Woolworth is the island's largest retailing group with five department stores in Cyprus. A sixth in the centre of capital Nicosia is under construction and is expected to open later this year.
It registered turnover of 37 million pounds in 1996, up 47 percent on 1995.

Last week the Cyprus Trading Corporation, an associate company, announced it would seek a listing on the Athens bourse as part of a drive to strengthen the capital base of the firm, which imports consumer items. ($=0.53 pound)
